description: Foundations for round 2 (plan.md steps 1-6; marketing-site tasks 30-34 plus roles.ts and the KeypadPicture helpers): close the third design review in the docs (V32-V35), the six motion tokens, RANKING_SENT, the build-time data for How (4663), Spell (Mihai 64424) and the proof's closing line, the motion engine in motion.ts and SiteMotion (play observers, step observer, deferred How start), and the shared drawing kit (pictures/roles.ts, KeypadPicture rings and single keys, the site.css role system, stages, grids and bento). Nothing visible changes yet except new CSS that no markup uses; the round-1 drawings and A5 rules stay until FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 replace them.
steps: Step 1 of plan.md: add V32-V35 to .agents/tasks/marketing-landing-v2/decisions.md; in .agents/tasks/marketing-landing-v2/design.md use the reviewer's shouldPlay body (design-review.md finding 1) in 3.3, scope the 3.3 mount bullet to data-play roots, write SWEEP/DIGIT_LINE/CHIP/TYPING as tuples (finding NIT 3), fix the 4.1 Step 3 row (34px, 152px) and the ring-dip sentence; edit .kiro/specs/marketing-site/requirements.md (Play line glossary, MS-8.11, MS-8.12 '632px' and 'the step that became active', MS-8.13 scoped to data-play roots), .kiro/specs/marketing-site/design.md R2.2 shouldPlay sentence, docs/decisions/ADR-006-landing-page-at-root.md A7 bullet, and a note under tasks.md task 29.

Step 2: append motion-state 200ms, motion-nudge 8px, motion-play-lead 300ms, motion-frame 600ms, motion-frame-quick 400ms, motion-sweep 240ms to design/system/tokens.json motion.tokens after motion-reveal-distance (usage text from design.md 3.1); run `pnpm -F @ninth/web tokens`; update the exact name list in test/tokens.test.ts 'MS-8.2 emits every motion token...' and add 'MS-8.2 the round-2 motion tokens are on :root with their values'. Tick task 30 / 30.1.

Step 3: export RANKING_SENT (4 items, as const) from packages/web/lib/rankingProvider.ts; new packages/web/test/ranking-provider.test.ts 'MS-7.10 RANKING_SENT maps to codes, lattice, beams and context.partner' using buildRequest from lib/decodeClient.ts (signature buildRequest(codes, lat, partner, mode, k = 5, beams = [])). Tick task 31 / 31.1.

Step 4: in packages/web/components/site/site-data.ts change HowData/getHowData to 4663 (typing tuple, sentences top 3, chosen = index of 'home', throws, digits-only fallback), add SpellExample/getSpellExample, proofSaidLine, finishedKeys, and type reject.diffAt as ProofColumn (0-4) with a throw when out of range; give getHowData/getSpellExample an optional test-only dictionary parameter so the throw cases can be tested (pattern: getResults(read)). Replace the 'MS-7.4 every How it works sentence encodes to 44' case in test/site-data.test.ts with the four task 32.1 cases. How.tsx keeps compiling (it passes how.sentences to HowFrames). Tick task 32 / 32.1.

Step 5: add splitInitialPlay, shouldPlay (V32 body), activeStep, howStart to packages/web/components/site/motion.ts; extend SiteMotion.tsx move()/still()/cleanup per design.md 3.3: instant marks before data-site-motion='on', play-area observer ('0px 0px -30% 0px', [0, 1]) and top-line observer ('0px 0px -100% 0px', 0) sharing one handler, step observer ('-50% 0px -50% 0px', 0) over .site-how__step writing data-how-step/-live/-play on .site-how, howStart read once on the first move(). Create the new observers only when their targets exist and before the reveal observer (lastObserver() in the existing tests must stay the reveal observer). Add the 13 task 33.1 cases to test/site-motion.test.tsx with the reviewer's extra shouldPlay cases. Tick task 33 / 33.1.

Step 6: new packages/web/components/site/pictures/roles.ts (KStep, UStep, Span, PlayClass, role overloads incl. the 'late' ring, play, lastChangeMs); KeypadPicture.tsx gets KeyRing + optional rings prop (div.site-key-ring inside the key), KEY_DRAWING_XL_SIZE '84px', TOUCH_MIN_SIZE 'var(--key-min)', TOUCH_XL_SIZE 'var(--key-xl)' and KeyPicture (one key with inline --nl-key on its own wrapper, outside .nl-keypad). site.css additions only: base role rules outside at-rules, .site-cell, .site-stage + height modifiers, .site-key-ring, .site-drawn-btn position relative, .site-drawing .nl-candidate cursor default, .site-grid--boxes, the Access bento with .site-card--tall and its growing stage; inside the motion block the step classes, play classes, --play-lead on :is([data-play], .site-how__picture), --play-i column rules, before-play and play rules (fill backwards), keyframes site-in/site-out/site-rise; late ring via `--late: calc(var(--motion-jump) * 0)` on .site-ring and `.site-ring.site-late { --late: var(--motion-jump); }` (no 0ms literal). In test/site-css.test.ts widen the MS-8.2 var allow-list to --(motion|reveal-i|play-lead|play-step|k|u|late)\b and add the six task 34.1 cases (fill test scope: selectors matching /\[data-play|\[data-how-play|site-how__picture/). New test/site-roles.test.ts ('MS-8.11 role and play build the step classes', 'MS-8.11 lastChangeMs adds the lead, the step and the change'). In test/site.test.tsx add 'MS-11.6 the page markup is at most 15 KB gzip' with today's measured gzip size in a comment; if today's page is already over 15 KB, stop and send_message severity 'warning'. Tick task 34 / 34.1.
Add a docs/KIRO_LOG.md row for the round-2 research and design phase (plan.md step 14 command 1) and one for this FEAT with `node scripts/kiro-log.mjs add` (credits blank).
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run` shows every test passing except site.test.tsx MS-4.1 (the known baseline failure); test/tokens.test.ts, test/ranking-provider.test.ts, test/site-data.test.ts, test/site-motion.test.tsx, test/site-css.test.ts and test/site-roles.test.ts all pass, including every new case named in tasks 30.1-34.1
styles/tokens.css equals the generator output (tokens.test 'matches the committed styles/tokens.css')
site.test.tsx 'MS-11.6 the page markup is at most 15 KB gzip' passes and its comment records the measured baseline size
`node scripts/tm-lint.mjs` on every changed file exits 0
verification: pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run > /tmp/nl-web.log 2>&1; echo exit $? >> /tmp/nl-web.log  (only MS-4.1 may fail)
findings: MARKUP: MS-11.6 baseline measured before any round-2 drawing: 7,149 bytes gzip (limit 15 * 1024 = 15,360); recorded in the test comment in site.test.tsx (describe 'client islands and imports (MS-11.3)'). TESTS: web 364 of 365 pass, the only failure is the known MS-4.1 copy case; typecheck passes. New files test/ranking-provider.test.ts (1 case) and test/site-roles.test.ts (2 cases). tokens.test.ts: 6 names added to the exact list + new 'MS-8.2 the round-2 motion tokens...'. site-data.test.ts: the 'MS-7.4 every How it works sentence encodes to 44' case is replaced by the four 32.1 cases (the finishedKeys check sits in the proofSaidLine case). site-motion.test.tsx: 15 new cases (the 13 of 33.1, plus 'MS-8.12 a How picture in view at mount plays the step a fast scroll reached' and 'MS-8.11 cleanup disconnects the play and step observers'); the new describe mocks getBoundingClientRect (data-top/data-bottom) and HTMLElement.prototype.getClientRects (data-nobox = no box) and finds observers by rootMargin, so lastObserver() stays the reveal observer. site-css.test.ts: MS-8.2 var allow-list widened to --(motion|reveal-i|play-lead|play-step|k|u|late)\b; six 34.1 cases in a new describe 'site.css round 2'. Old A5 cases untouched. DATA API: getHowData(dict = dictionary()) and getSpellExample(dict = dictionary()) take an optional SiteDictionary ({lexicon, lm} | null; null = no dictionary; exported types Dictionary, SiteDictionary). HowData = {code:'4663', typing:[4 strings], sentences (raw lowercase words, decoder order, today good/home/gone), chosen (index of 'home')}; typing is sentence-cased, digits-only fallback '4','4 6','4 6 6','4 6 6 3'. Exports also ProofColumn, isProofColumn (internal), proofSaidLine, finishedKeys, SpellExample. NOTE: the round-1 HowFrames now gets the 4663 sentences, so until FEAT-002 the round-1 How drawing shows 'good' rows where it showed 'hi'; How.tsx copy unchanged. CSS NAMES: base (outside at-rules) '.site-out, .site-during, .site-ring { opacity: 0; }', .site-cell, .site-drawing .nl-candidate, .site-key-ring, .site-key-picture (KeyPicture wrapper, display inline-grid), .site-stage (216px default, surface-sunken; surface inside .site-band--surface), .site-stage--privacy (288px), .site-stage--switch (block-size auto, min-height 384px). How stage heights 416/288/160 are NOT added (FEAT-002, step 7). .site-drawn-btn now position: relative. All step/play/lead/late/--play-i rules are prefixed [data-site-motion="on"] inside the no-preference block (the 34.1 test requires that prefix on every selector part); --play-i rules use :is(:nth-child(2), :nth-child(4), :nth-child(5)) for Access 648-1023 and override nth-child(4) to 0 and nth-child(3) to 2 from 1024. The late ring is '[data-site-motion="on"] .site-ring { --late: calc(var(--motion-jump) * 0); }' and '.site-ring.site-late { --late: var(--motion-jump); }'. Keyframes site-in, site-out, site-rise added (A5's nine stay). GRIDS: .site-grid--access lost its round-1 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(288px, 1fr))' and is now the bento columns (1 col, 2 from 648px, 3 from 1024px) with .site-card--tall placement; visible only at 960-1023px, where the round-1 Access grid shows 2 columns instead of 3 until FEAT-003. .site-grid--boxes is new (no markup yet); .site-grid--2 stays. A new @media (min-width: 648px) block sits after the 600px block; the short-landscape block is still last. KEYPAD: KeypadPicture has rings?: readonly KeyRing[] ({key: KeyId, k, u, late?}) rendering div.site-key-ring inside each key (no change to markup without rings); new constants KEY_DRAWING_XL_SIZE '84px', TOUCH_MIN_SIZE 'var(--key-min)', TOUCH_XL_SIZE 'var(--key-xl)', type SingleKeySize; KeyPicture({id, size, rings?, className?}) renders div.site-key-picture[style=--nl-key] > div.nl-key.site-key (className goes on the key, for example site-key--touch). ROLES: pictures/roles.ts role/play/lastChangeMs as design 3.2; lastChangeMs uses 200 ms for fades, 120 ms for ring/mark and adds 120 ms to a late ring's k end. SITEMOTION: play observers and step observer are created only when targets exist, before the reveal observer; howStart read once (howAsked); still() also resets the written step so the step observer rewrites data-how-step after a move(). DOCS: V32-V35 in decisions.md; design.md 3.2 (late ring without 0ms, tuple tables), 3.3 (V32 body + callback notes, mount bullet scoped), 4.1 (ring dip, Step 3 row 34px/152px), section 9 shouldPlay cases; requirements glossary Play line, MS-8.11, MS-8.12 (632px, the step that became active), MS-8.13 (data-play roots); spec design.md R2.2; ADR-006 A7; tasks.md note under task 29 and tasks 30-34 ticked (task 35 is not ticked although roles.ts and the rings prop are done; FEAT-002 ticks it with HowScreen). KIRO_LOG rows 28 (research and design) and 29 (FEAT-001) added.
